title: Chapter 6.  Local Government - MCD, NDMC & Delhi Cantonment

blocks.content: Delhi's civic administration is unusually fragmented among multiple local bodies rather than one unified municipal corporation for the whole NCT - a structural quirk that is a favourite source of comparative/list-based exam questions.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Delhi's municipal governance is managed across three main local bodies, restructured from a total of five.
The primary municipal jurisdictions are MCD (Municipal Corporation of Delhi), NDMC (New Delhi Municipal Council), and Delhi Cantonment.
Mayoral political dynamics play a crucial role in civic administration and local governance in Delhi.

blocks.content: Unlike most Indian metropolitan cities governed by a single municipal corporation, Delhi's civic administration is divided among THREE distinct local bodies, each with jurisdiction over a different part of the NCT.

From 2012 to 2022, the erstwhile Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) was itself trifurcated into three separate corporations - North, South and East Delhi Municipal Corporations - to improve administrative manageability; however, this arrangement was reversed via the Delhi Municipal Corporation (Amendment) Act, 2022, which UNIFIED the three back into a single Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) with effect from May 2022, citing financial unviability and coordination problems in the trifurcated structure.

cells: The bulk of the NCT's area and population
Re-unified in May 2022 (after a 2012-2022 trifurcation into North/South/East MCDs); India's largest municipal corporation by population served
The Lutyens' Delhi/New Delhi area (VIP zone housing Parliament, Rashtrapati Bhavan, central govt offices)
A statutory body, not fully elected - Chairperson and most members are nominated by the Central Government, with only limited elected representation
Administered under the Cantonments Act, jointly by military and civic representatives, for the defence-establishment area

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: 'MCD is India's largest municipal corporation' is a frequently tested one-liner - remember it was reunified from three corporations (North/South/East) back into one in 2022, reversing the 2012 trifurcation.

items: Differentiate the administrative scopes and governance structures of MCD, NDMC, and Delhi Cantonment Board.
Note the structural transition from five local civic bodies to three in Delhi's urban administration.

The Mayor of Delhi (MCD) is an indirectly elected ceremonial-cum-administrative head chosen by the elected councillors, with the post rotating annually and reserved seats (for women, SC candidates) cycling through in a fixed sequence.

MCD elections in December 2022 (the first since reunification) saw AAP win a majority of council seats, ending 15 years of BJP control of the erstwhile MCD; this made MCD control split from Assembly-level Delhi Government control for a period, an unusual 'divided government' phase in Delhi's civic history until the BJP's 2025 Assembly win realigned control.
Delhi has THREE local bodies: MCD (bulk of NCT), NDMC (New Delhi/Lutyens' zone, largely nominated), Delhi Cantonment Board (military zone).
MCD was trifurcated (North/South/East) in 2012, then RE-UNIFIED into a single MCD in May 2022.
MCD is India's largest municipal corporation by population served.
NDMC uniquely has a largely NOMINATED (not elected) governing council, given its VIP/central-government-zone character.
